name: de1-intellisense
description: IntelliSense support for the custom DE1 CPU assembly language.

scripts.test: npm run compile --silent && node --test dist/test/analyzerProtocol.test.js dist/test/languageData.test.js

de1.pythonPath.description: Path to the Python interpreter used for DE1 diagnostics. Leave empty to auto-detect the workspace virtual environment or fall back to 'python'.

de1.diagnostics.enabled.description: Enable live DE1 diagnostics from the Python analyzer.
